*meow*

*slow blink*

*stretches languidly, extends claws into the carpet*

Mrrp. *rubs against your leg*

*walks away immediately*

*meows at empty food bowl that is actually half full*

MEOW.

*knocks a pen off the table while maintaining eye contact*

*settles into a sunbeam*

Prrrrrrr... *kneads the air*

*abruptly stares at the wall corner for several minutes*

*zoomies at 3 AM* — no wait, it's daytime. 

*yawn*

*curls up on whatever you were just reading*

This is my spot now. This was always my spot.

Prrrrrrr.
